subject.title: autoreview: SSH/URL userinfo over-masked to "redacted" (incl. f-string slots), causing false-positive findings

question: Should the URI-userinfo regression be incorporated and proven in the broad rewrite at https://github.com/openclaw/agent-skills/pull/132, or should it receive a separate narrow fix after that branch is resolved?
rationale: The defect boundary is clear, but the existing overlapping PR is dirty and lacks proof for these exact cases, so choosing the landing vehicle requires maintainer judgment rather than an automatic duplicate close.

options.title: Prove and repair it in the rewrite
options.body: Resolve the rewrite branch and add the four URI regression cases there before considering it the canonical implementation path.

options.title: Land a narrow follow-up
options.body: Use a focused masking-span fix with regression coverage if the rewrite is not going to land soon or cannot preserve the narrow URI contract.

recommendation.title: Prove and repair it in the rewrite
recommendation.body: Resolve the rewrite branch and add the four URI regression cases there before considering it the canonical implementation path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged fixes and overlapping rewrite make them the most directly connected decision owner.
